Maria (People Ops): Hey @channel — quick operational question. Team in Berlin wants to take PTO Tue–Wed next week but Mon is a local public holiday in DE. If they file PTO for Tue–Wed will Mon automatically be marked as the holiday (so no PTO is consumed)? Also a related manager question: can an engineer swap a core-hours day for a floating holiday without formal manager approval if the team confirms coverage in-thread?

Alex T: In practice public holidays are auto-applied if location is set correctly in the HR portal. If someone’s location is wrong it can fall through—then PTO gets charged and we do a manual correction.

Sophie L: Policy note — core-hour swaps that affect team coverage need manager sign-off. If it’s just shifting hours the same day (e.g., 9–5 -> 11–7) that can be agreed ad-hoc, but anything that changes on-call/rotation needs formal OK.

Max R: Payroll note: deadline for next pay period adjustments is Tue 10:00 PT. Manual retro changes are a pain after cutoff. Also, carryover exceptions (cap exceeded due to holiday overlap) require people-ops review.

Maria (People Ops): TL;DR steps for the Berlin case: 1) employee verifies "location" in profile, 2) file PTO for Tue–Wed in HR portal, 3) if Mon not auto-applied file a "holiday alignment" request via the HR ticket form so PTO is not charged, 4) for core-hour swaps: get manager sign-off + cc people-ops and log change in the schedule-change form.

Maria (People Ops): Pasting the relevant policy snippet so managers know what to approve:

"Public holidays for the employee's registered work location will be applied automatically. If a public holiday overlaps with a requested PTO day, the public holiday will be applied and PTO will not be deducted. Core-hour swaps that materially affect team coverage require manager approval; minor same-day schedule adjustments may be documented with manager acknowledgment and do not require escalation."

Sophie L: Would be nice to automate manager acknowledgement via a Slack workflow — e.g., manager clicks Approve and it logs to the schedule-change form. @Maria any bandwidth for a quick POC? :slightly_smiling_face:

Maria (People Ops): Yes, we can prototype next week. Meanwhile, please use this approval template in threads so HR/payroll can process quickly:
Manager: approve — swapping Fri core hours 9–12 to Tue 13–17, no coverage impact. cc @people-ops :thumbsup:

Alex T: Fyi contractors are excluded from floating-holiday rules. Contractors must use PTO unless it’s a company-observed holiday.

Payroll Bot: payroll-bot: Reminder — payroll cutoff Mon 2026-03-23 23:59 UTC for manual attendance/pay corrections. :bell:

Max R: If a real case comes up, DM me and I can flag it to payroll so we don't miss the cutoff. Also tag benefits@redwood.com for carryover exceptions.

Maria (People Ops): Thanks! I’ll draft a 1-pager and the Slack workflow mockup. If anyone has a live example please post it here or DM me and I’ll help file the alignment request.
